michelle-rodriguez.text: Campaign lists seven priorities: Safe Neighborhoods, Cleaner Air and Water, Healthcare for All, Jobs and the Economy, Women's Equality, Homelessness, and Schools and Higher Education.
Campaign priority listed as "Healthcare for All."
Campaign priority listed as "Cleaner Air and Water."
Campaign priority listed as "Homelessness." No specific approach was stated on the pages retrieved.
Public safety platform: "work with local police departments to fund and implement community policing programs."
Served as a Commissioner on the California Commission on Peace Officer Standards and Training (POST) before her election.

Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Professional Peace Officers' Association, California Coalition of Law Enforcement Associations, California Police Chiefs Association, and California Correctional Peace Officers Association.
Serves on the Assembly Banking and Finance, Revenue and Taxation, Insurance, Public Employment and Retirement, Economic Development, Governmental Organization, and Rules committees.

source.title: Assembly Member Rodriguez - California State Assembly

michelle-rodriguez.text: Authored AB 1628 (child protection: safe surrender), AB 2006 (daycare centers in state office buildings), AB 2453 (off-highway motor vehicles), and AB 744 (alcohol tied-house exceptions) in the 2025-26 session; she is Assistant Majority Whip.

notes: Rodriguez (incumbent): no floor-vote records or issue-page text on housing, renters, guns, immigration, labor, elections could be retrieved (leginfo/asmdc.org pages failed or lacked vote data; Digital Democracy page did not show votes), and she left the Vote411 guide blank. Items are campaign priorities, committee roles, authored bills, and endorsements only. Romero (Republican, special education aide): no campaign website; evidence is from her Vote411 answers and a CAGOP endorsement listing; no positions found on renters, homelessness, climate, labor, immigration, social issues, guns, health care, transportation, elections.
